dict.string: Lumen can skip and pause songs in Apple Music when you say "Lumen, nästa låt".
When you ask, Lumen adds events to your calendar and tells you what is in it. It always asks before it adds something.
When you ask, Lumen adds reminders. It always asks before it adds one.
When you ask, Lumen sets timers and alarms. It asks before it sets an alarm.
Take a photo of the page you are studying, so Lumen can quiz you on it. The text is read on the iPhone; the photo is not saved.
Lumen listens to the room through your microphone to transcribe speech and answer questions in your AirPods. Audio is streamed for transcription and is not saved.
In Provläge you can answer a yes/no check question by nodding or shaking your head with your AirPods. Only used then.
Lumen can use the iPhone's own speech recognition, as a fallback or when you switch off cloud recognition in Settings.
